blockingFindings.title: Header id has no matching test name
blockingFindings.issue: The header declares R4, but the file has no 'R4: ...' test name.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a 'R4: ...' test name or remove R4 from the header.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The coverage artifact claims requirement coverage that the test body does not expose.

blockingFindings.title: R3 fingerprint coverage misses required input classes
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test verifies content/add/remove changes for src/ and plugins/, but does not verify that content changes, additions, or removals under .senti/config.json, the active spec.json, or active spec tests/ change the repair fingerprint.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local R3 assertions that mutate .senti/config.json, the active spec.json, and active spec tests/ inputs and verify the fingerprint changes for required content/add/remove cases where applicable.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3 explicitly requires fingerprint changes for every addition, removal, or content change across these inputs; several required input classes have no corresponding test coverage.

blockingFindings.title: R4 downstream reset coverage is incomplete
blockingFindings.issue: The repair completion test verifies promotion back to test-execute and evidence invalidation, but it does not verify that downstream implementation leaves through finalize-cleanup are reset as required.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an R4 assertion through the public CLI/status surface that downstream implementation leaves through finalize-cleanup are reset after impl-repair completes.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 requires both invalidation and lifecycle reset behavior; the reset-through-finalize-cleanup portion has no corresponding executable coverage.

blockingFindings.title: Coverage artifact validation contradicts declared coverage
blockingFindings.issue: The artifact reports validation.ok=false because tests/repair-closure-cli.test.js declares R4 and R6 in the header without matching `R4:` and `R6:` test names, while still marking R4 and R6 as covered by that file.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Make the coverage artifact and test names agree, either by renaming the relevant tests to include spec-local `R4:` and `R6:` names or by correcting the artifact so it no longer reports invalid coverage metadata.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement coverage artifact is internally inconsistent with the actual test-name mapping, which is an explicit blocking condition for this review.
